newsitem.title: USA: Irish leader in Washington for EC-U.S. summit.
newsitem.headline: Irish leader in Washington for EC-U.S. summit.

text.p: Irish Prime Minister John Bruton, current president of the European Union, arrived in Washington on Sunday for an EU-U.S. meeting.

Irish Embassy spokesman Adrian O'Neill confirmed Bruton's arrival and said the prime minister would spend a private evening preparing to meet on Monday with President Bill Clinton and European Commission President Jacques Santer.
A meeting between Bruton and Santer originally scheduled for Sunday evening was postponed until Monday, O'Neill said.
He said the regularly scheduled summit, one of two Brussels and Washington hold each year, would cover a wide range of issues, including trade, economic conditions, crime and the drug trade.
Trade with China and Beijing's desire to join the World Trade Organisation will also be discussed, European officials said.
